shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic/face motif carved into rock
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic figural carving reduced to bold outlined forms, and both include a rounded/spiral element read as a head or eye, but that is a generic correspondence any pecking tradition could produce. A shows a crowded field of full-body stick-like human figures with limbs, long connecting lines and ladder/grid motifs spread over a flat panel, whereas B presents a single large isolated face-like mask with a prominent spiral eye occupying one boulder, with no comparable scene, groupings or interactions.
